behavior: Migratory and usually forages low in vegetation, hopping along branches, fallen wood, and the ground while gleaning insects, often above water. Nests in tree cavities or nest boxes; males sing repeated ringing notes during the breeding season.
field_marks: Bright golden-yellow head and underparts with an unmarked face
Yellow-olive back contrasting with blue-gray wings
Short blue-gray tail with white visible beneath
Long, stout, pointed dark bill and round black eye
Stocky, big-headed proportions with short dark-gray legs
habitat: Breeds in wooded swamps, flooded bottomland forests, and shady woods bordering slow-moving or standing water, especially where standing dead trees provide nesting cavities. In the nonbreeding season, inhabits mangroves and lowland forests near streams and ponds.
